prior_importants.description: Gate pipeline diagram routes a taken ADR number to "Rejected: re-steered; blocked after 2", but decision 146 makes it a refusal: no rejection counted, nothing steered.
Guide says `pup launch` and `pup kill` refuse everyone but the operator; the source lets the conductor launch and plain-kill, refusing it only `kill --respawn`.

findings.description: In the gate diagram, the `soft -->|yes, no --accept-debt| rej` edge still sends unaccepted flagged debt to the re-steered rejection. The gate actually refuses it (`refuseGate`, src/core/merge-gate.service.ts L2374), which is the same outcome as the new Refused node, so this edge should point to `refuse`.

`refuse --> endr` sends the refusal to "back to running". A refusal changes no state (ADR 0146 L60): a merged session re-gating its PR stays merged. Give `refuse` its own end node, such as "session keeps its state".

The new `running --> merged: pup kill of a fix round` edge leaves out that `pup kill` also returns a blocked fix-round session to merged (src/core/session-state.utils.ts L35). Add `blocked --> merged` or say "from running or blocked".

In the operator-only list, the new `pup kill --respawn` entry is the only one without an ADR link. ADR 0042 L14 and ADR 0047 L38 both support it, so link one of them, as the PR's cite-the-ADR goal asks.

process_issues.description: Round 2 reviewed only the incremental delta: 4 markdown files, +7/-6. Both prior importants are resolved. The ADR 146 refusal now has its own Refused node in gate-and-debt.md, and the operator list in concepts.md and commands.md now says `pup launch` and `pup kill` are open to the conductor, with only `kill --respawn` operator-only. The docs reviewer checked both against src/cli/index.ts and ADR 0146. Only docs and conventions were spawned, because the delta is prose only. Correctness, security, context, simplicity, guards and maintainability were skipped because no code changed, workflow-safety because no workflow changed, and spec because there is no spec source. The consolidator merged nothing. No importants, so no validators ran.
